rule: This file records where shared Xizong learning/runtime work should continue. It is not medical Core, not learner state, and not a substitute for study-policy.json. A fresh Chat should read this cursor together with the referenced Current owners before proposing new Xizong work.

current_system.reason: A2 is the current generalization/validation system for the shared Xizong learning runtime.

next_action.instruction: Do not add another Xizong learning feature yet. Run the Current A2 exit path as a learner: System Recall -> explicitly lock full-paper holdout years -> enter the remaining respiratory System sweep -> verify answer interaction and Wrong/Uncertain handling -> copy a real W/U packet to Chat -> finish with a short System Recall. Use observed friction to decide only the smallest next patch.
next_action.success_condition: The learner can complete the A2 exit path without answer leakage before Recall, accidental holdout consumption, duplicate review work, guessed Question-to-KP mapping, or unnecessary interaction overhead. Wrong/Uncertain evidence reaches Chat with enough detail to distinguish memory, mechanism, precision, distractor/condition, and product/content problems.
next_action.validation_note: Current runtime/source identity and repository Astro build/CI have been checked successfully. Real learner use of the complete A2 System Exit path is still the next and stronger validation evidence.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not add more learning-stage taxonomies merely for completeness.
Do not turn KianOS into a second Lecture or require duplicate long-form reading.
Do not equate MI-D with Precision or turn Precision into a separate first-pass drill queue.
Do not put Connection Hooks into ordinary Memory or turn Reserve Learning into a second course.
Do not rebuild the respiratory 359-question System scope by model inference; its Current deterministic scope is restored and runtime-validated by count/hash/Question Truth existence.
Do not infer Question-to-Block/KP mappings from title similarity, page proximity, System membership, source section, or model intuition.
Do not treat System-level question membership as the same authority as the explicit Chat-reviewed Question-to-Knowledge relation owner.
Do not auto-select or auto-consume full-paper holdout papers. The learner explicitly chooses them.
Do not recover circulation/urinary System question scopes merely for completeness until real A2 System Exit use shows this Runtime shape is worth generalizing.
Do not optimize for more UI controls, cards, metadata, or governance files without observed learning benefit.
Do not use legacy repository content as normal Current authority. The bounded respiratory historical recovery exception is closed.
after_validation: If the A2 System Exit flow is good in real use, recover the already-audited circulation and urinary System-level scopes using the same deterministic Current pattern rather than re-reviewing those questions from scratch.
Only deepen Question-to-Block/KP relations for Wrong/Uncertain or otherwise high-value questions unless second-round strategy provides new evidence.
Preserve the frozen first-pass -> second-pass -> late-review stage responsibilities and System-level true-question strategy from study-policy.json.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update this file only at meaningful shared-work stage transitions or when the next shared Xizong action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, study-policy.json, and only the Current owners needed by next_action. Continue from next_action instead of reconstructing the roadmap from legacy chats.
